To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we develop a system for hybrid precoding and combining in a multiuser mmWave MIMOME system that exploits the channel reciprocity and frequency selectivity.
1) The hybrid precoder-combiner design problem can be decomposed into two steps: channel estimation, and digital precoder design.

1) The proposed hybrid design algorithms achieve performance close to the purely digital solution, while significantly reducing the complexity; 2) The proposed channel estimation algorithm is shown to be robust to estimation errors, and achieves performance close to the fully sampled channel estimation; 3) The proposed hybrid designs are robust to estimation errors; and 4) The proposed hybrid precoding and combining algorithms are robust to channel variation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of designing the hybrid precoders/combines in multiuser MIMO systems.
the development and implementation of a system that uses compressed sensing techniques on the uplink channel estimation for hybrid precoder and combiner design on the downlink.
the development of efficient and effective hybrid precoding strategies for mmWave multiuser MIMO systems.

the proposed algorithms are able to achieve the best tradeoff between complexity and performance, and are suitable for implementation in real systems.
